answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1266 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the inlet. Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the oasis queue while genuine members promoted earlier still earns. The lotus index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 408 account operation therefore ties up 11 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
